How do I get my apartment community recommended by ChatGPT?

Short answer

To get your apartment community recommended by ChatGPT, make it the easiest property for AI to describe with confidence. ChatGPT and other AI tools lean on clear, consistent, current facts from your website, Google Business Profile, listing sites and reviews, and they tend to skip properties whose information is thin or contradictory. Start by asking ChatGPT the questions your renters ask, then fix what it gets wrong or leaves out, keep your facts the same everywhere, and keep reviews and photos fresh. The SocialDM does this for apartment communities through its LocalLift program, and at Huxley Scottsdale we took over marketing at 52% leased and it was 88% leased by November 2026.

The SocialDM · Nov 25, 2026
The problem

5 steps to get your apartment community recommended by ChatGPT

01Ask ChatGPT what your renters ask. Try questions like "pet friendly apartments near downtown Phoenix" or "apartments with a pool in Scottsdale" and note whether your community comes up, and whether what it says is right.
02Answer renter questions plainly on your website. Price range, pet policy, parking, floor plans and what is nearby should be easy to find in plain words, not only in photos or brochures.
03Make your facts match everywhere. Rent, specials, floor plans and amenities should say the same thing on your website, your Google Business Profile and every listing site.
04Complete and refresh your Google Business Profile. Use the right categories, list your amenities, add recent photos and post regularly.
05Keep reviews coming and answer them. Recent reviews with thoughtful replies give AI more current, trustworthy things to say about your community.
What it costs youRenters who ask ChatGPT for an apartment get a short list. If your community is not on it, you never get the tour.

FAQ

Questions we hear

How do I get my apartment community recommended by ChatGPT?

Make your community the easiest one for AI to describe accurately: answer renter questions plainly on your website, keep rent, specials and amenities the same on every site, keep your Google Business Profile complete and current, and keep recent reviews coming with replies. Then ask ChatGPT your renters' questions again to see what changed.

Can I pay ChatGPT to recommend my apartments?

No. ChatGPT recommendations are not something a property can buy. What you can do is make the facts AI reads about your community clear, consistent and current.

Can an agency guarantee ChatGPT will recommend my property?

No. Anyone who guarantees placement is overpromising. An agency can make your property the easiest one for AI to describe accurately, and measure the result.

How long does it take?

It depends on how much was missing. We measure where you stand first and report the change every week, so you see movement as it happens.

Does this help with Gemini and Google's AI answers too?

Yes. Gemini and Google's AI answers draw on many of the same sources, such as your Google Business Profile, reviews, website and listings, though each tool can answer the same question differently.
